messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started — service=search-svc, version=2026.04-rc3, region=ap-southeast, target=15%, change_window=02:00-05:00 UTC. Monitor SLOs. :rocket:

mary: seeing p95 increase at ~02:08 UTC, +30ms, and a tiny 5xx bump (0.03%). opening search dashboard.

josh: linking: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/ijkl/search-p95 — seems concentrated on nodes ap-southeast-2b. KV miss rate up on those hosts.

lin: tailing logs: one host shows repeated timeouts to kv-proxy during heavy batched requests.

deploy-bot: SLO guard fired: error_budget_remaining=1.9% (threshold 2.5%). Alerting thread. :warning:

mary: recommend pausing canary in ap-southeast and pin to 2026.03-stable while we triage. Small blast radius.

josh: agreed. ops-bot, can you apply routing pin?

ops-bot: Running: `routingctl pin --service search-svc --region ap-southeast --version 2026.03-stable --note "canary hold: p95/5xx trend"`

ops-bot: Result: routing updated -> 100% traffic to 2026.03-stable in ap-southeast. Canary STOPPED. Ticket https://tickets.redwood.ai/ENG-5255 created.

lin: adding traces and sample request ids to ENG-5255. Likely kv-proxy backpressure with larger batch windows.

mary: updating release notes with brief line pointing to ENG-5255. Will reconvene after triage.

deploy-bot: Monitoring watch closed for this thread. Re-open if new alerts appear.
